# Anthropic acquires confidential-computing data startup Opaque Systems

A quiet day for product and release news, with the signal mostly coming from two acquisitions. Most of the rest of the Google News feed was homonym noise — fashion shows, football scores and festival merchandise matching "Snowflake" and "Redshift" as plain words rather than the database products.

## Top stories
- **[Anthropic Acquires Confidential AI Startup Opaque Systems](https://news.google.?oc=5)** — SecurityWeek. Anthropic has acquired Opaque Systems, a startup building confidential computing infrastructure for secure data collaboration. *Why it matters:* confidential computing underpins secure data clean rooms and cross-org data sharing, a recurring governance problem for platform teams.
- **[Adastra acquires Poland-based data and AI consultancy Infinite Services](https://news.google.?oc=5)** — Consultancy.eu. Canadian data and AI consultancy Adastra has acquired Infinite Services, expanding its presence in Poland. *Why it matters:* continued consolidation among data consultancies as demand for platform and AI implementation work grows.

## Worth reading
- **[What Is Delta Lake and Why Does It Matter for Lakehouse Architecture](https://medium.com/@mydata_insights/what-is-delta-lake-and-why-does-it-matter-for-lakehouse-architecture-264ad5831133?source=rss------data_platform-5)** — An introduction to how Delta Lake's transaction log and versioning make a data lake behave like a database.
